commands.name: render.texture
commands.description: Use a loaded texture through per-object TextureSource.
commands.requirements: SpriteRenderer or MeshRenderer; loaded asset; GPU required to display.

commands.name: render.material
commands.requirements: Loaded material name; changes the target renderer.

commands.name: render.pipeline
commands.requirements: Pipeline name must exist in active engine configuration.

commands.name: render.uv
commands.description: Normalized image crop, flip and UV rotation in radians.
commands.requirements: SpriteRenderer; instance-only UV replaces prior rectangle.

commands.name: render.layout
commands.requirements: Root sprite with XY unit quad; one root unrotated unscaled Camera2D auto-resolved by CameraRenderer target or explicit cameraName. Camera2D projection is 0..width,0..height. every_frame for ongoing sync; ensure foreground order.

commands.name: render.target
commands.requirements: Destination object owns a Window or ScreenBuffer; source owns Sprite/Mesh/Text/CameraRenderer.

commands.name: render.order
commands.requirements: Integer int32; respects engine pipeline ordering.

commands.name: render.layer
commands.description: Named draw order layer Background/World/UI/Overlay mapped to -10000/0/10000/20000, or direct int32.
commands.requirements: Draw sorting convention only; no collision or culling layers; respects pipeline ordering.

commands.name: render.material_parameter
commands.description: Change shared material standard field or extra shader parameter.
commands.requirements: Explicit shared:true; loaded material. Standard color/specularColor/rimColor, shininess/rimPower/rimIntensity/uvRotation, uvTranslate/uvScale/uvPivot, enableLighting/enableShadowMapProjection. extra:true supports float/bool/vec4 matching compiled shader field. No material file is saved.

commands.name: post.configure
commands.requirements: Existing effect component. Use generic property tween for animated values; reflection paths and type validated.

commands.name: text.style
commands.description: Set text font size, color/opacity and optional font name.
commands.requirements: TextRenderer; font argument requires loaded font; alpha 0..1; size positive.

commands.name: text.format
commands.description: Format numeric text with decimal places and padding.
commands.requirements: TextRenderer; decimals 0..9, width 0..128; value expression can be resolved by common command adapter.

commands.name: camera.configure
commands.description: Create or configure Camera2D/Camera3D reflected projection properties.
commands.requirements: Mode 2d or 3d; camera renderer separately via component.add and render.target; generic property tween animates projection.

commands.name: render_target.configure
commands.description: Create/configure screen_buffer, window or overlay on target object.
commands.requirements: GPU/window system required for actual render target creation; width/height integer 1..16384; window optional syncTransform.

commands.name: component.add
commands.description: Add registered component, optionally configure reflected values.
commands.requirements: One existing component of same name causes error; recursive ShortTextBehavior prohibited; does not auto-create a new object.

commands.name: component.remove
commands.requirements: Transform and currently executing ShortTextBehavior are protected.

commands.name: component.configure
commands.description: Set typed reflected member values with snapshot rollback on failure.
commands.requirements: Existing component and nonempty values; unknown/type mismatch rejected before mutation.

limitations: Layout assumes an XY unit quad, root Transform, and root unrotated unscaled Camera2D; arbitrary hierarchy/perspective fitting is not supported.
Named layer is priority convention, not true render/collision/culling layer.
Material changes are shared and not persisted to asset files.
Shader extra parameters require matching compiled material layout; mismatched names do not create new shader features.
Runtime adapter only; GUI/GPU behavior requires manual verification.
